title: Inversion monotonicity in subclasses of the 1324-avoiders
summary: A collection $B$ of patterns is called inversion monotone if $\mathrm{av}_n^k(B)$, the number of $B$-avoiding permutations of length $n$ with $k$ inversions, is weakly increasing in $n$ for any fixed $k$. In 2012, Claesson, Jelínek and Steingrímsson posed the inversion monotonicity conjecture, which states that the pattern $1324$ is inversion monotone and implies a new upper bound for its Stanley--Wilf limit.
